en: What...? Is this...?
This looks like your research lab.
It is, right?

Let's see what's in here.
But...I'm getting a bad feeling from this place.
<CLT=cltMIND>A bad feeling?

How did you know that this was
the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Detective<CLT=cltNORMAL>'s lab?
I could tell...just from looking.

But this place doesn't match you at all. I think
this lab is too good for someone like you.

Ahaha, you might be right...
First I need a cloak and a deerstalker.

What...? The clothes wouldn't even look
good on you.
It won't suit you at all, so don't even try it.

This definitely looks like a lab for
a detective...

This place doesn't match you at all. I think
this lab is too good for someone like you.
You never complain about Kaito's attitude...

I guess you're really taken in to being
his sidekick.
<CLT=cltMIND>I'll investigate around here a little more.
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us,
but why is it so...gaudy?

<CLT=cltMIND>And it's not just the monitor,
it's this entire academy.
<CLT=cltMIND>What is going on here...?

<CLT=cltMIND>Bottles line the shelves behind the
glass door. Are these...?
It looks like...poison.
So you think so too, huh?

There's no way that can be normal medicine in
the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Detective<CLT=cltNORMAL>'s lab...

<CLT=cltMIND>She opened the cabinet's glass door
and peered inside.

Yeah, I know what some of these are.
They're definitely poison.

In that case...we should try to dispose of them.
We don't want anyone accidentally—

Even if we got rid of them, Monokuma would
just replace them.

So it's useless doing that. It would only be
a temporary solution.
<CLT=cltMIND>A temporary solution...

<CLT=cltMIND>She wants to make *sure* no one
will ever use them.

Even so...I'm surprised they have so many
in here.

There's poison for instantaneous death, as well
as ones that can inflict various symptoms...

Depending on how you use them, you can
set up different gimmicks.

This doesn't feel like an <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Detective<CLT=cltNORMAL>'s lab.
More like a criminal's lab.

It's a fine line when it comes to knowing
everything about crimes.

<CLT=cltMIND>I suppose that's right... There's a fine
line between criminal and detective.

<CLT=cltMIND>There's a fine line between
criminal and detective.

There are a bunch of files lined up.
It looks like about 50 of them.
What are these files for?

<CLT=cltMIND>I picked one up at random and
flipped through it.
Ah!

<CLT=cltMIND>It contained photographs of murder
scenes and the <CLT=cltSTRONG>tricks the culprits used<CLT=cltMIND>.
What is this...?

<CLT=cltMIND>I hurriedly looked through the other
files and found that they were all similar.

...It's a file containing all the tricks used
for murders.
It appears so.
Did this incident really happen?

I can't be sure, but there are
pictures of the scene.
And all of these cases seem feasible.
Feasible, huh?

Then this would make a good guideline for
anyone who wants to commit murder.

Well, I doubt anyone's that stupid to use a
file that's accessible to everyone...

<CLT=cltMIND>Maki picked up a file at random
and started flipping through it.

Huh? This file doesn't have any photographs.
It's all just drawn illustrations, but...
Illustrations?

<CLT=cltMIND>Maki began pulling files one after
the other off of the shelf.

The newer files have photographs, but the
older ones have illustrations?
But why? Are the old ones <CLT=cltSTRONG>just fictional<CLT=cltNORMAL>?

<CLT=cltMIND>The first few files have only illustrations,
but the others have photographs...
<CLT=cltMIND>Is there a reason for that?

<CLT=cltMIND>The first few files have only illustrations,
but the others have photographs...
<CLT=cltMIND>Is there a reason for that?

<CLT=cltMIND>Anyway, I've investigated all the
places that concerned me.
Everything here has to do with death.

Well, that is your job as a detective,
especially in this killing game.
Yeah...I know.

The only time I can use my detective talent
is after someone dies...

A detective...can't save anyone. I'm only
useful after it's already too late.

Why are you so upset all of a sudden?
Do you want to die?
You'd kill me just for that!?

Nah, I understand why Maki Roll would
say that. Your face looked pretty gloomy.
Kaito?

With a face as gloomy as that, I can't 
believe you're my sidekick.

Be more proud of yourself, Shuichi!
Everything you've done up till now is amazing!
Ah...thanks.
That's why you should be careful.
Huh? What do you mean?

Because of how well you did in the class trials,
<CLT=cltSTRONG>future culprits<CLT=cltNORMAL> have their eyes on you...
The next culprit might come after you.
Come after me?

Heh, you don't need to worry about that!
I won't let anyone mess with my sidekick!

I'm gonna protect both of you!
It's a hero's job to protect his sidekicks!
...What if I end up as a <CLT=cltSTRONG>future culprit<CLT=cltNORMAL>?
Are you stupid? That's impossible.
How...can you believe in people so easily?

Huh? Didn't I tell you before?
I believe in people I wanna believe in.

And if they betray me, it just means I 
made a bad call believing in them.

Of course, you're one of the people I 
want to believe in, Maki Roll!

Why are you even here? Did you finish
playing tag with Kokichi?

I lost track of him. I can't find 
that guy anywhere.

Couldn't find him?
But he still has the <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive card key<CLT=cltNORMAL>, right?
Yeah, he should still have it.

<CLT=cltMIND>There's a chance that Kokichi could have
used the card key and gone somewhere...

Well, he ended up getting away, 
but look what I found!
It's the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback Light<CLT=cltNORMAL>!
Ah, you found one!

I am worried about Kokichi, but I think 
we should deal with this first.
So let's all gather in the dining hall!
...Huh? I'm coming, too?
Ah, wait a minute!

There are other places I want to check first!
Can I meet up with you later?

Oh yeah?
Then I'll go on ahead to the dining hall.

I'll let Shuichi handle it!
You got this. Right, Shuichi!?
Y-Yeah...right.

Then once you're done, come to 
the dining hall.
